title.zh: LoomWard · 织盾 · 基于 Cordis 内核的综合本地 Agent 安全管控平台
title.en: LoomWard · Cordis-Based Local Agent Security & Control Plane

summary.zh: 基于 Cordis 4 微内核与 pnpm monorepo 构建的个人综合 Agent 管控平台，融合 Cloudflare OAuth 2.1 远程中继、本机逐参人工审批、只读 Linux Docker 沙箱、第三方 MCP 聚合、防泄漏护栏与人机决策台账。
summary.en: Cordis 4 monorepo local Agent control plane unifying Cloudflare OAuth 2.1 remote MCP relay, exact local approval, read-only Linux Docker sandboxes, third-party MCP aggregation, anti-leak guardrails, and a decision ledger.

zh: 以 Cordis 4 + 冻结根插件清单（RPM）+ PolicyTree 为安全内核，机械守卫包间分层，第三方与跨语言扩展严格运行在进程外边界
完整保留单次精确审批、24 小时防重放账本、只读 Linux Docker 容器沙箱及 Windows/macOS/Linux 受保护宿主运行时与回环 PassKey 控制台
采用 monorepo 架构整合远程桥接、R1–R7 防泄漏护栏与人机决策台账，并为 CloudForge 与 ModelBridge 预留独立外部适配接口
en: Powered by a Cordis 4 microkernel with frozen Root Plugin Manifests (RPM), PolicyTree guards, mechanical layering checks, and strict out-of-process extension boundaries
Preserves exact per-request local approval, 24h replay ledgers, disposable read-only Linux Docker sandboxes, cross-platform credential vaults, and PassKey-authenticated loopback WebUI
Consolidates remote bridge, R1–R7 anti-leak guardrails, and decision ledger in a pnpm monorepo while keeping CloudForge and ModelBridge standalone via adapter interfaces

milestone.zh: 已完成旧项目双端归档（archive/*）、更名为 LoomWard · 织盾，并落地 pnpm workspace monorepo 与 Cordis 4 微内核骨架。
milestone.en: Archived predecessor repos into archive/* branches, renamed to LoomWard, and established the pnpm workspace monorepo and Cordis 4 microkernel skeleton.
